observation_model.interrogation: angular response at 633 nm over 60-80 degrees
observation_model.photon_budget: total across all bins and all exposures; divided by exposure allocation then evenly across bins
observation_model.background: 0.001 of incident photons in each bin, scaled with that exposure's photon allocation
observation_model.likelihood: independent Poisson counts in the abstract bin model

terminology_correction: derivative norm retained is a length ratio; information fraction retained is its square
interpretation_limit: scenario-based local geometry and deterministic pseudo-true fitting; no Monte Carlo confirmation or empirical drift distribution
